page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon processor, the ecs.hfg5.xlarge is suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, application servers, and moderate database hosting where local storage is not a prerequisite.
